label: First Light · fixture basis

antares.label: ANTARES · SkyPulse legacy demo export
antares.native_ontology: ANTARES locus: an alert-aggregated sky position. ANTARES tags are filter-pipeline memberships, not astrophysical classes.

time.scale_basis: The historical ANTARES exporter treats MJD as UTC. In this legacy demo the stored value was synthesized by the demo exporter.
time.date_binning: UTC date of the UTC-treated MJD, half-open [00:00, 24:00) UTC.
time.entity_date_rule: UTC date of newest_alert_observation_time (demo date_utc; synthetic assignment).

fink.label: Fink · committed acquisition evidence + synthetic fixture population
fink.native_ontology: Rubin DiaSource rows delivered by Fink (Light Static packet). DiaObject is a derived grouping key; broker fields are source-time snapshots.

time.scale_basis: Fink analysis_contract_v1: midpointMjdTai is the authoritative observation time, MJD on the TAI scale.
time.date_binning: UTC date of the TAI time converted with a leap-second table, half-open [00:00, 24:00) UTC. Fixture conversion: TAI − UTC = 37 s (valid since 2017-01-01); a real adapter must use ERFA/Astropy.
time.entity_date_rule: UTC date of the first delivered DiaSource of the DiaObject in this basis.

invariants: An ANTARES locus is not a Fink DiaObject.
An ANTARES tag is not an astrophysical class.
A Fink classification is a source-time snapshot, not a timeless object classification.
A model score is not a calibrated probability.
Fink lag-zero transport is not Rubin scientific completeness.
Readable Parquet is not science readiness.
A missing ANTARES night is not a zero-row night.
Source density is not survey coverage.
Fink midpointMjdTai is TAI; the historical ANTARES exporter treats MJD as UTC. They are never silently aligned.
No cross-broker identity matching is performed in this basis.
